ITEM 1 | Single triangular slice with golden-orange crust edge, bright red-orange sauce layer, and white melted cheese with browned spots; topped with round pepperoni-like disks showing slightly darker red centers and glossy oily sheen; slice about 11 cm long and 6 cm wide at the crust end, roughly 1.5 cm thick, sitting in the upper-right area of a white square plate covering about 12% of the plate | 110

ITEM 2 | Stacked second slice partly overlapping the first, same orange crust, red sauce, and white cheese with browning, with a folded corner of cheese at the tip; sits on top of the first slice near the upper edge of the plate, about 9 cm by 5 cm and roughly 1.5 cm thick, covering about 8% of the plate | 80
